verdict.rationale: Bitbucket is a SaaS dev platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. A probe found an official Atlassian MCP server documented at github.com/atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server, which is first-party evidence that an agent connection path exists. The pack does not show which Bitbucket operations it exposes, how to set it up, or how it authenticates, so depth and Bitbucket-specific coverage are unproven. Missing for 10: confirmation that the server covers Bitbucket repos, PRs and pipelines; setup and auth documentation; independent or hands-on corroboration.
